folds.heading: ## Price-spike reconciliation B121, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full EL1–EL7, A–E results, S0–S2 and test plan read. Keep the reported extraction and exclusions as dated research, not a current recipe census or a reproduced calculation. The printed primary pin list has 22 named entries while the table/text claim 24 plus two fallback pins. Recover the exact inputs before reproducing; do not invent missing anchors or silently change historical totals. “Category-set” prices and roughly fifty required anchors are interpretations/bounded estimates, not proven author intent or a universal anchor budget. All-recipe cheapest paths also differ from a learned-only player graph.

The section 2.4 no-buy/craft/sell-profit conclusion does not follow from a 4–7× trader markup: the same spike reports paths with about 15× authored/derived ratio. That ratio alone also does not prove profit, since intermediate purchase costs, source availability, quality, success/yield, fuel, actual quote rounding, skill and saturation matter. EL7 already leaves the full simulation unrun. Acyclic recipe conversions do not prove the larger acquisition/trade/ledger graph has no profitable loop. No new actual profit or exploit is claimed here.

Test 2 should require non-increasing value on a same-good round trip, with equality allowed at zero fee when units divide exactly; strictly less at every fee is false. Floor credits/ceil charges prevent rounding gains within that specified transaction, not every cross-issuer/market cycle. A cyclic solver needs explicit gain-cycle/pin/rounding behavior; one fixture settling at a pin does not establish all fixed-point convergence. Card13’s universal worse-than-merchant and cannot-mint wording is therefore qualified, not a proven world law.

Recomputing an unsaved price map does not alone establish save compatibility: saved balances, learned path receipts, revised anchors/definitions and pending quotes need explicit adoption/freeze policy. Existing [B107 carry review](../GENETICS_CONSTITUTIONS_AND_BROOD_PLAY.md#body-lineage-b3-reconciliation-b107-2026-11-04) qualified blanket no card-specific heir carry; it does not settle this card’s carrier/balance reset policy. The proposed second-currency home must follow actual current owners and AD51, not a mandatory wait-for-second-currency rule. Quality-blind tariffs, emission/stock backing, learned paths, fees and cross-issuer arbitrage remain local proposal dials. S0’s final default question is unselected work, not authorization to build a module or deepen Frontier.

folds.heading: ## Card 13 reconciliation B121, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The complete [Equivalence Ledger spike](audits/EQUIVALENCE_LEDGER_SPIKE_2026-10-23.md#price-spike-reconciliation-b121-2026-11-04) and card13 body are now read. Preserve the issuer tariff, known recipe path, anchor provenance, exact-item transaction, carrier/account and visible-fee idea as a proposal. The historical “cannot mint value” and “clearly worse than selling to a merchant” sentences are not established invariants: a recipe DAG does not cover market/ledger cycles, and actual merchant demand/quotes and path costs vary. Zero-fee exact round trips may break even. Its promise is a selected tariff mechanism, not a proof that market price equals making cost or that material emission has no backing requirement.

Before a selected implementation, recover the exact pin inputs (22 names printed versus24 claimed), define supported quality/identity/source/recognition and learned-path scope, and reconcile issuer emission/stock/currency ownership. Recomputed prices do not waive compatibility for existing credit or paid/frozen quotes. Preserve local powerful/free variants where their mechanism supports them; no universal market-spread penalty is imposed. Existing card-specific carry paths qualify the old blanket IM7 absence without deciding card13’s own carrier/reset policy. No S0/S1/S2 build was selected or executed, and full-library coverage is not claimed.

folds.heading: ## Equivalence-tariff reconciliation B121, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The complete [equivalence spike](audits/EQUIVALENCE_LEDGER_SPIKE_2026-10-23.md#price-spike-reconciliation-b121-2026-11-04) preserves a proposed issuer tariff distinct from market valuation. Its 4–7× markup argument does not rule out every buy/craft/sell margin, and recipe acyclicity does not cover the complete market/ledger graph. Actual costs, quality, success/yield, fuel, quotes and saturation remain necessary for a selected comparison. Floor/ceil round trips should be non-increasing, allowing exact equality at zero fee. No live economy prices or balance were changed; pin-input discrepancy, learned-path reach and price-revision compatibility remain explicit before implementation.
